mcpStudio.title: MCP server
mcpStudio.lede: Choose which of this server's tools agents can call, and how each one is described and shaped.
mcpStudio.boardFailed: The kill switch board did not load, so this page cannot show which switches are on or turn one off.
mcpStudio.truncated: The kill switch board holds more switches than one read returns, so a switch on this server may be missing here.

missing.title: Server not found
missing.body: This workspace holds no MCP server with that id. It may have been removed.

tools.title: Tools
tools.missing: Discovery has not listed this server's tools yet. The table shows the tools the registry holds.
tools.readOnly: Only an organization owner or admin can import tools or change their classification.
tools.refused: The draft cannot hold that edit, so it was not kept. Remove an edit on the Changes tab or discard the draft first.

empty.title: No tools
empty.body: The server listed no tools the last time Oxagen read it.

budget.title: Definition budget
budget.missing: The definition budget is set in tools.toml, and Oxagen has not read this server's tools.toml yet.
budget.unmeasured: The budget is {budget} tokens. Some imported tools have no measured definition, so the total is not known.

listed.counts: {imported} imported of {offered} the last discovery listed
listed.search: These definitions would fit the budget better behind tool search.
listed.compileError: The server's tools.toml did not compile. Fix it in the steering repository.

panel.unclassified: This tool has no classification yet.

basis.source_hint: From a hint in the source definition.
basis.grpc_idempotency: From the gRPC method's idempotency level.
basis.fail_safe: No signal was found, so the most cautious class was chosen.

panel.importFirst: Import this tool before you change its classification or description.
panel.draftHint: Draft asks a model to write the description. Its cost is billed as in-app agent spend.
panel.draftNotBuilt: Draft is not available yet. You can write the description yourself.
panel.draftError: Draft did not finish. Try again.
panel.shapingMissing: Shaping is set in tools.toml, and Oxagen has not read this server's tools.toml yet.
panel.serverMissing: Oxagen has not recorded what the server says about this tool yet.
panel.feedbackMissing: Oxagen has not recorded how agents use this tool yet.
panel.refused: The draft cannot hold that edit, so it was not kept. Remove an edit on the Changes tab or discard the draft first.
panel.offNone: The registry holds no version of this tool, so it has no switch to turn off.

connection.withheld: Hidden because it is not a vault reference

source.title: Source
source.missing: Oxagen has not recorded where this server came from yet. The facts below come from the registry.

environments.title: Environments
environments.agentsUnset: No environment is set for agents yet.

auth.title: Authentication
auth.note: A credential stays in the Oxagen vault. This page shows only its reference, and a steering PR does not carry it.
auth.name: Credential name
auth.nameHint: Lowercase letters, digits and dashes. server.toml names the credential by this.
auth.secretHint: Sent once to the Oxagen vault. This page never shows it again.
auth.failed: The credential was not stored. Oxagen answered {code}.
auth.thrown: The credential was not stored because the request failed before Oxagen answered. Try again.

machines.title: Machines
machines.body: The local gateway runs this server on enrolled machines. Oxagen sends it no credential.

try.title: Try a tool
try.live: This environment is not a sandbox. The call reaches the real service.
try.argsHint: A JSON object with the tool's arguments.
try.badJson: The arguments are not a JSON object.
try.credentialNote: The call is recorded and metered like an agent's. The request shown omits the credential because the gateway adds it after recording.
try.tooLarge: The test was not saved. It is larger than a draft allows, or the draft is full.
try.badRecord: This call's record is not in the shape a saved test needs, so the test was not saved.
try.stripped: Removed the {headers} {count, plural, one {header} other {headers}} before saving, because a saved test never holds a credential.
try.error: The call did not finish. Try again.

empty.title: No imported tools
empty.body: Import a tool on the Tools tab to try it here.

empty.title: No changes
empty.body: Edits you make on the Tools tab and tests you save on the Test tab collect here.

ops.test: Add a test call to {tool} in {environment}

files.title: Files
files.folderMissing: Oxagen has not recorded this server's steering folder yet, so the paths are the defaults.

surface.title: Tool surface
surface.none: The tools agents see do not change.

findings.title: Findings
findings.missing: Findings show once this server's folder is recorded.

pr.title: Steering PR
pr.body: Open steering PR writes the draft to the server's steering folder as a pull request. A person merges it before agents see the change.
pr.readOnly: Only an organization owner or admin can open a steering PR.
pr.failed: The steering PR did not open. Oxagen answered {code}.
pr.thrown: The steering PR did not open because the request failed before Oxagen answered. Try again.
pr.conflict: Someone saved this server's draft after you last did. Your edits are now staged on top of theirs. Check the edits, then open the steering PR again.
pr.conflictDropped: {count, plural, one {# edit did not fit the saved draft and was left out.} other {# edits did not fit the saved draft and were left out.}}
pr.kept: Someone saved this server's draft after you last did, in a form this page cannot read. Your edits are unchanged, and Oxagen kept theirs. Reload the page to get a version that can read their edits, then open the steering PR again.
pr.folderMissing: Oxagen has not recorded this server's steering folder yet, so a steering PR cannot be opened from here.
pr.sourceMissing: The steering PR needs the server's definition to go with this draft, and Oxagen has not recorded it yet.
pr.overBudget: The imported tools come to {tokens} definition tokens, over this server's budget of {budget}. The steering PR will carry an over-budget warning.

codes.denied: Only an organization owner or admin, or a workspace owner, can open a steering PR.
codes.invalid: Oxagen could not read the draft this page sent. Reload the page, then open the steering PR again.
codes.unavailable: Oxagen could not open the steering PR just now. Try again in a minute.
codes.pending_approval: Opening this steering PR waits on an approval. Open it again once the request is approved.
codes.exhausted: This workspace has reached a usage limit. Open the steering PR again once the limit resets.
codes.too_large: This draft is over the 960 KiB this page can send in one request. Discard some edits, then open the steering PR again. The Oxagen API and MCP tools save drafts up to 8 MiB.
codes.draft_not_found: Oxagen holds no saved draft for this server. Open the steering PR again to save your edits.
codes.draft_unchanged: The steering PR already holds these edits.
codes.draft_unreadable: The saved draft no longer matches the draft format. Discard the draft, then make the edits again.
codes.server_not_found: Oxagen has no record of this server in this workspace.
codes.server_toml_missing: The server has no server.toml on the production branch. Set up its connection, then open the steering PR again.
codes.server_toml_invalid: The server's server.toml does not validate. Fix it in the steering repository, then open the steering PR again.
codes.server_name_mismatch: The server's server.toml names a different folder. Fix the name in the steering repository, then open the steering PR again.
codes.workspace_repository_missing: This workspace has no steering repository. Connect one, then open the steering PR again.
codes.production_branch_missing: The steering repository has no production branch. Push one, then open the steering PR again.
codes.folder_invalid: The server's steering folder does not compile with these edits. Check the edits, then open the steering PR again.
codes.source_required: The steering PR needs the server's definition to go with these edits. Import the server's tools again, then open the steering PR.
codes.source_invalid: The definition does not match the server's source. Import the server's tools again, then open the steering PR.
codes.source_commit_missing: The draft does not say which commit its definition came from. Import the definition again, then open the steering PR.
codes.definition_path_invalid: The definition names a file outside the server's folder. Import the definition again, then open the steering PR.
codes.importer_not_built: Oxagen cannot import this kind of definition yet.
codes.tools_unclassified: Every imported tool needs a risk, a side effect, and an egress. Classify each one, then open the steering PR again.
codes.tool_not_found: The draft changes a tool that neither tools.toml nor the source holds. Discard that edit, then open the steering PR again.
codes.tool_not_offered: The source no longer offers a tool this draft imports. Remove it from the draft, then open the steering PR again.
codes.tool_key_collision: Two tools in this draft share one key in tools.toml. Remove one of them, then open the steering PR again.
codes.test_invalid: A saved test cannot be recorded. Save the test again, then open the steering PR.
codes.test_holds_credential: A saved test carries a credential header. Remove the header, save the test again, then open the steering PR.

fields.name: Folder name
fields.nameHint: The server's folder under tools/servers/. Lowercase letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter, at most 24.
fields.label: Display name

definition.intro: Upload an OpenAPI, GraphQL or gRPC definition. Oxagen saves it as a draft and opens a steering PR that adds the server's folder. A person merges the PR before agents see the server.
definition.urlHint: The address agents' calls go to. It must not carry a user name, a password or a key.

filesHint.openapi: The OpenAPI document, and any file it references.
filesHint.grpc: The .proto files. Oxagen stores each one under proto/.

definition.exists: A draft named {name} is already saved. Open that server in Studio, or choose another folder name.
definition.moved: Someone saved the {name} draft after you did. Open that server in Studio to see their edits.
definition.tooLarge: These files are over the 960 KiB this page can send in one request. The Oxagen API and MCP tools accept definitions up to 25 MiB.
definition.tomlInvalid: Oxagen could not read the server settings this form wrote. Check the name, the URL and the description, then try again.
definition.sourceInvalid: Oxagen could not read the definition. Check the files and the definition type, then try again.

problems.name: Enter a folder name of lowercase letters, digits and underscores that starts with a letter, at most 24.
problems.reserved: The folder name builtin is reserved. Choose another.
problems.label: Enter a display name of at most 80 characters.
problems.description: Enter a description of at most 200 characters.
problems.url: Enter an http or https URL with no user name or password.
problems.files: Choose at least one definition file.
problems.duplicate: Two files are named {file}. Rename one of them.
problems.entry: Choose the root document from the uploaded files.
problems.graphqlOne: A GraphQL definition is one schema file.

local.intro: A local command runs on enrolled machines through the local gateway. A machine in its groups lists its tools before the steering PR opens. Oxagen sends it no credential.
local.commandHint: The program the local gateway starts, such as npx.
local.variablesHint: One name per line. Each machine sets the value.
local.machinesHint: One group per line. A machine you enrolled in one of these groups lists the tools.
local.versionHint: The version of the program the command runs.
local.digestHint: Run shasum -a 256 on the file the command resolves to on the machine. The machine starts nothing else.

package.intro: The local gateway runs this package on enrolled machines. Oxagen reads its SHA-256 from the registry, and a machine in its groups lists its tools before the steering PR opens. Oxagen sends it no credential.
package.unpinned: Oxagen pins npm, PyPI, and NuGet packages. This entry offers {types}.
package.noPackage: This entry lists no package a machine can run.

discovery.title: Discovery
discovery.unnamed: Discovery starts once the server's folder merges. Its progress shows on the server's Tools tab.
discovery.none: Discovery has not run for this server yet.
discovery.stalled: This discovery has waited over an hour.

outcomes.unchanged: The server's tools have not changed.
outcomes.pr_opened: Discovery opened a steering PR with the server's tools.
outcomes.pr_updated: Discovery updated the server's steering PR.
outcomes.needs_digest: The package needs a pinned digest before discovery can move its version.

discovery.toolCount: {count, plural, one {# tool listed} other {# tools listed}}
discovery.failed: Discovery did not answer. Oxagen answered {code}.
discovery.thrown: Discovery did not answer because the request failed before Oxagen answered. Try again.

machine.exists: A draft named {name} is already saved. Open that server in Studio, or choose another folder name.
machine.moved: Someone saved the {name} draft after you did. Close this dialog and add the server under another folder name.
machine.unlisted: No machine listed the tools. Check that a machine in these groups is online and that the pin matches what it runs, then list the tools again.
machine.needsDigest: Oxagen cannot pin this package type yet. Choose an npm or NuGet package.
machine.registryUnreachable: Oxagen could not read the package from its registry. Try again in a few minutes.
machine.tomlInvalid: Oxagen could not read the server settings this form wrote. Check each field, then try again.

problems.name: Enter a folder name of lowercase letters, digits and underscores that starts with a letter, at most 24.
problems.reserved: The folder name builtin is reserved. Choose another.
problems.label: Enter a display name of at most 80 characters.
problems.description: Enter a description of at most 200 characters.
problems.command: Enter the command the local gateway starts.
problems.arguments: Enter at most 256 arguments of at most 4096 characters each.
problems.variable: {name} is not a variable name. Use letters, digits and underscores, starting with a letter or an underscore.
problems.machines: Enter at least one machine group.
problems.machine: {group} is not a machine group. Use lowercase letters, digits and hyphens.
problems.version: Enter the version the command runs, at most 64 characters.
problems.digest: Enter the SHA-256 as 64 hexadecimal characters.
problems.entryVersion: The registry lists no version for this entry, so Oxagen cannot pin it.
problems.argumentInvalid: The value for {argument} has a $ that names no variable. Write $$ for one $, or $'{'NAME'}' for a variable.

machine.notYours: You enrolled no machine in these groups. A listing runs only on a machine you enrolled, so enroll one and add it to a group first.
machine.resumable: A draft named {name} is saved with no tools listed. List the tools again to save this form over it.

listing.title: Tool listing
listing.none: No listing is saved for this server yet.
listing.waiting: A machine in {groups} lists the tools when it next polls Oxagen.
listing.readFailed: Oxagen did not answer the listing read. It answered {code}.
listing.thrown: The listing read failed before Oxagen answered. Read it again.

classify.title: Tools to import
classify.intro: {count, plural, one {The machine listed # tool.} other {The machine listed # tools.}} Studio suggests a classification for each. Confirm or change it before the steering PR opens.
classify.none: Pick at least one tool to import.
classify.moved: Someone saved the {name} draft while you picked its tools. Submit again to save your picks over their draft.
